title: Netflix opens 250M-user inventory to Trade Desk buyers, drops spend minimums

facts.fact: Netflix inventory became available to every buyer using The Trade Desk's Sellers and Publishers 500+ marketplace, per The Trade Desk's platform resources page published July 20, 2026.
facts.quote: Netflix inventory today became available to every buyer using The Trade Desk's Sellers and Publishers 500+ marketplace, removing the private-deal requirement

facts.fact: According to The Trade Desk, reaching Netflix inventory through Sellers and Publishers 500+ requires no minimum spend.
facts.quote: "no minimum spend or change to your workflow required to reach Netflix inventory."

facts.fact: Before the change, advertisers reaching Netflix via The Trade Desk could only use programmatic guaranteed deals or 1:1 private marketplace arrangements, which typically carried scale commitments smaller advertisers could not meet.
facts.quote: Both require direct engagement and, typically, scale commitments that smaller advertisers cannot meet.

facts.fact: According to The Trade Desk, the Netflix inclusion gives buyers access to Netflix's more than 250 million global monthly active users.
facts.quote: the inclusion gives buyers access to Netflix's more than 250 million global monthly active users

facts.fact: At its 2026 advertising upfront on May 13, 2026, Netflix put its global monthly ad-supported reach at 250 million viewers.
facts.quote: when the company put its global monthly ad-supported reach at

facts.fact: Netflix's 250 million figure counts individual viewers within ad-supported households rather than subscriber accounts, according to the source.
facts.quote: The 250 million figure represents individual viewers within ad-supported households rather than subscriber accounts

facts.fact: Netflix has been chasing roughly $3 billion in advertising revenue for 2026.
facts.quote: Netflix has spent 2026 chasing roughly $3 billion in advertising revenue for the year

facts.fact: Netflix generated approximately $1.5 billion in advertising revenue in 2025.
facts.quote: nearly double the approximately $1.5 billion it generated in 2025

facts.fact: Netflix reported second-quarter revenue of $12.56 billion, a 13.4 percent year-over-year gain.
facts.quote: second-quarter revenue of $12.56 billion

facts.fact: Netflix shares fell roughly 8 percent after its second-quarter revenue report, which fell just short of its own guidance.
facts.quote: sent shares down roughly 8 percent

facts.fact: Netflix told investors on its first-quarter 2026 earnings call that programmatic buying was on course to exceed 50 percent of its non-live advertising business.
facts.quote: programmatic buying was on course to become more than 50 percent of its
